claims: No. 3 seed Illinois faces No. 9 seed Iowa in the 2026 NCAA Tournament Elite Eight on Saturday, March 28, 2026.
Illinois defeated Iowa 75-69 on Jan. 11, 2026, at Carver-Hawkeye Arena.
Illinois defeated Houston 65-55 in the Sweet 16.
Iowa defeated Nebraska in the Sweet 16.
The 2026 NCAA Tournament Elite Eight matchup is #3 Illinois Fighting Illini vs. #9 Iowa Hawkeyes.
The 2026 NCAA Tournament Elite Eight matchup is at Toyota Center in Houston, Texas.
The 2026 NCAA Tournament Elite Eight matchup is at 5:09 p.m. CT.
Illinois advanced to their first Elite Eight since 2005.
Iowa reached the Elite Eight for the first time since 1987.
Illinois is favored over Iowa in the Elite Eight matchup.
Illinois went 9-1 in their last 10 matchups against Iowa between 2021 and 2026.
